notes.title: Bug fix 6/21 ver.e0002bugfix2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
	-Fixed a bug that caused a crash when hitting certain attackable objects or enemies with resistant attributes.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements 6/18 ver.e0002bugfix1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
	-Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when hitting certain attackable objects or enemies with weak attacks. 
Improvements
	-Improved determination of whether a player has entered a tight space. The possibility of getting stuck on a nondescript step has been greatly reduced.

notes.title: A little big update 6/13 ver.e0002
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
	-Fixed damage handling in special situations
	-Fixed a bug that some enemies did not turn around properly in special situations
	-Fixed a bug that money throwing does not reduce money under certain conditions, sorry.
	-Fixed a bug so that the normal attributes are applied when a bundle of money is burned
	-Fixed a bug that an achievement related to collecting could not be obtained when a specific treasure chest was obtained last.
	-Fixed a bug where the attribute was not correctly applied to the blast.
	-Fixed a bug in which enemies did not move to certain states correctly.
	-Fixed a bug where some characters' animations were not displayed correctly
	-Fixed the liking condition of the strongest it on this island and the condition to meet it to match both (part of the changes regarding the queen class below)
	-Fixed a bug where using money in slot machines was being treated like a purchase in a store.
		-Adjusted the event conditions for the number of purchases and the amount of money spent instead, 
adjusted what appeared to be a glitch and officially introduced it as a specification (part of the changes to the queen class below).
	-Fixed a bug that players did not move into position when fighting under certain conditions with the queen class.
	-Fixed a bug that prevented some queen classes from reacting correctly.
	-Fixed a bug where normal bats would not occur under certain conditions.
	-Fixed a bug in the calculation process used in some physical judgments
	-Fixed a bug in which opening a treasure chest in the tutorial room would not cause anger.
	-Fixed an error in the timing of some sound effects.
	-Fixed a bug in which some background music was referring to the volume of sound effects
	-Fixed a bug that certain mechanical enemies kept dropping unnecessarily
	-Fixed a bug in which events that occur under special conditions did not occur at unnecessary times.
Improvements
	-Slightly improved visibility of some enemy attacks
	-Improved the way all map data is managed to reduce the occurrence of glitches due to mistakes during development, which should not be dependent on gameplay
	-Improved the data management of all maps to reduce glitches caused by development mistakes, should not be dependent on gameplay. Processing speed should be lightened just a little bit.
	-Improved behavior and presentation of some queen classes when attacking in battle
	-Improved the behavior and processing of bats as a whole, so that they move naturally and do not need to be processed unnecessarily in certain actions. Processing speed should be just a little bit lighter.
	-Changed the resume point to be set closer to the queen class when in combat with the queen class. 
With this change, part of the start point after defeating the queen class has been unified with the resume point. 
Removed some checkpoints near the queen class that were deemed unnecessary.
	-When losing a duel against a queen class, the game will restart with a special weapon equipped so that the duel can be resumed immediately.
	-Improved the instant death attacks of certain queen classes so that they do not spread unreasonably too far to the side.
	-Improved so that certain attacks that attract players who may fall to their deaths do not attract them while they are not in control.
	-Fixed the darkening of the screen after a battle with the queen class
	-Improved so that when the environment before and after moving to a room by door etc. becomes land or underwater, if the player is in a state where damage can be prevented by equipping an item in his/her possession, the item is automatically equipped. 
With this, there is a time when the player cannot move for only one frame at the beginning of the stage. There should be no change in the sense of play unless you are doing something like a speed run.
	-Changed the internal specification of the detection method of the detector.
	-Some doors that did not respond to detectors before have been made to respond.
	-Tweaked the position of some stone slabs.
	-Tweaking of footsteps and positions when moving around the stage, etc.
	-Almost all sound effects have been changed so that they do not sound the same at the same time.
	-Changed the structure of the map so that the momentum of some races does not cause them to enter portals.
	-Slightly extended the grace period for bomb jumps.
	-Changed the specifications of the bomb dash. Changed so that the bomb dash transitions to a running state regardless of item possession status.
	Changed so that when a bomb dash is performed from a non-dash state, the initial movement is a little faster than a normal dash due to a slight inertia.
Change
	-Changed the respawn location after some forced death events. 
	-Small changes to the calculation process for attack attributes, but no changes to attack power, etc.
	-Changed and adjusted the timing, conditions, priority, and glitches of getting sensitivity of each queen class, as well as improved internal processing. 
Basically, changed the liking to not change for the better unless you face the queen class. 
This change made it easier for the queen class to dislike you before they like you, which makes it harder for them to betray you.
	-Some hearts have been changed to make it easier to understand the status of hearts.
	-Changed so that the weapon selected in the weapon menu screen does not become the equipped weapon when the player resumes the game after death.
	-Weapons equipped at the time of death will be carried over when resuming unless there are special conditions.
	-Changed so that attribute weakness and resistance multipliers can be set individually. Adjustments.
	-Adjusted the attack power of weapons according to the above. Effective and ineffective weapons may change slightly.
		Increased multiplier after reinforcing the glove of the key 
Decreased multiplier after reinforcing the glove of the whip.
	-All achievements are now determined when the ending is reached.
	-Changed some conditions for ending branching.
	-Changed some specifications of invisible walls and ceilings at the end of stages. They can no longer be climbed with a knife.
	-Changed the specifications of blocks that can be moved by pushing them. 
Changed so that when there are multiple supporting blocks, moving one of the supports will not cause it to get stuck. 
Changed so that the sound effect when a block falls from a height will be heard even if it extends off the screen a little.
	-Adjusted the price of store items
Additions
	-We have added a new queen to the game. This will slightly increase the difficulty of some achievements, and make it easier to get other items, etc.
	-Added a tablet associated with the new queen.
	-New attack patterns for the strongest ones.
	-Added a new item in the item field to check the destruction of the bosses, these are not items.
	-Added a simple display of defeat status and other information on the save data load screen.
	-Added special reactions of some existing queen classes under certain conditions.
	-It is now possible to be clearly disliked by certain characters.
	-Instantaneous transition to the weapon selection screen by pressing the switching buttons simultaneously on the menu screen.
	-Added a single dialogue illustration at the beginning of the game
Added internal processing
	-Added a process to load the old version's save data to correspond to the new version when loading, to make it easier to add new elements in the future

notes.title: Bug fix 2/5 ver.e0001bugfix11
notes.content:
Bug fixes
-Fixed freezing caused by special death patterns
-In conjunction with the above bug fixes, the death and survival confirmation process for all stamina-related things in the game has been unified.
The purpose is to eliminate and prevent bugs caused by inconsistent judgments.
There are enemies whose strength fluctuates to the extent of error, but the gameplay experience should be the same.
-Fixed so that characters react correctly to some events

notes.title: Bug fixes, changes, simple measures 2/4 ver.e0001bugfix10
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug that already purchased items were lined up again in the store
Changes
-Changed so that HP is recovered to the maximum when rematching some bosses.
Simple measure
-Add checkpoints near some bosses and far from save points, we will think of a better way.
If you have any suggestions for “I want it here if possible”, please let me know in the comments. We will consider implementation, including difficulty level, etc.

notes.title: Bug fixes, changes (+ a little important), weapon adjustment 2/3 ver.e0001bugfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug where some bosses would freeze.
-Fixed a bug that the number of jumps of the main character did not recover properly in certain conditions.
-Fixed an image in the options.
Changes
-Added a button for selection in the title and loading screen, to make it easier to understand the game for the first time.
-Added hints to some puzzles
	
Weapon adjustments
  
Initial weapons
-Increased the range and time of the bomb jump a little, extended the jump distance

Sparkly and powerful thing.
-We weakened it due to the financial situation of when it could be obtained and the fact that it was so useful and damaging.
Damage reduced, cooldown reduced, damage added when thrown at close range. It should still retain enough strength.

Sparkling heavy thing.
-Gives special effect against queen-rated, and overall damage adjusted accordingly.

Bouncy weak thing
-Slightly reduced blast attack, cooldown greatly reduced

Things to put on the ground
-Reduced cooldown, extended bomb jump distance
	
Some important changes
-Changed the loading method of save files, in case more elements are added in future updates.
I have confirmed that there are basically no problems with loading speeds, glitches, etc., but please contact us if you have any questions.

notes.title: Bug fixes and changes 2/1 ver.e0001bugfix8
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug in which a page could be sent back when the option to return to the title was selected.
-Fixed a bug in which some special effects were not oriented correctly.
-Fixed a bug in which captured items are generated correctly in events related to bottles
-Fixed a bug in the behavior of the bears.
Changes
-Improved the tutorial room, making it more visually clear.
-Changed the way of appearance that we originally wanted to do again.
-Added simplified explanatory images to options and configuration choices.
-Replaced some of the controller notations.
-The maximum number of collectibles displayed at the end of the game is now the maximum number of items currently available.

notes.title: Bug fixes, changes 1/29 ver.e0001bugfix7.5
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug that music did not play properly on some maps
-Fixed a display bug in the ending
-Fixed a bug in which you could purchase items you already have.
Changes
-Relaxed the judgment of anger of some characters.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements 1/29 ver.e0001bugfix7
notes.content:
Bug fixes
-Fixed a problem with stick input when using a pad
-Fixed a problem that occurs when opening a treasure chest at the start of a battle with the Queen of Snakes
-Just to be safe, some changes were made so that the player's inertia disappears when transitioning to other events
-Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when attacked by the Queen of Bats
-In battles with some queens, defeating an enemy that joins the battle during a duel will no longer lower your favorability
-Fixed a bottle-related crash
-Fixed a problem where the contents of the bottle were not generated properly
Improvements
-Changed the version notation due to bug fixes, etc. to include it in the title
Bugfixes are incremented by 1 for small updates such as this one, such as bug fixes.
The version is added when major elements are added or when save data transfer processing is required internally.

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Improvements, Changes, Announcements 1/28 2nd
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed misalignment of images in some events
-Fixed staging in some boss battles
-Fixed a bug in which some objects remained invincible
Improvements
-Improved processing of items for underwater use
-Improvements to the events that occur under certain conditions so that the player can guess what is likely to happen by looking at them
Changes
-Achievements have been eased, and the “Obtain all specific elements” type of achievements can now be obtained by obtaining all currently implemented achievements.
This will make you a true queen.
Some achievements will become more difficult to obtain with each future update.

Notice.
-We are planning to change the tutorial room and improve the menus to make them easier to understand in the next update, which will take some time and will require a longer period of time than before unless we discover a bug that interferes with the progress of the game that needs to be fixed first. We will take some time for this.

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Improvements, Additions 1/28
notes.content:
Bug Fixes, Improvements, Additions 1/28

Bug Fixes
-Fixed gimmicks related to some equipment items to behave correctly.
-Added money gimmick to some places where something might be there but nothing is there.
-Removed unnecessary stone slabs that were covered with content 
Improvements
-Improved an unreasonable riddle near the first save point. Made it more visible when a successful action is taken.
-Added a few hints where hints were lacking.
-Added some fluffy hints about hidden elements.
Additions

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvement 1/27
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug that certain holes did not have a fall detection.
-Added a gimmick to make money appear in some places where something might be there but nothing is there.
Improvements
-Display of corresponding buttons in file selection, menus, etc.
-Addition of items that respond to the detector.
-Changed the effect that appears depending on what the detector reacts to.
Improvements?
-Super tacked on, but options, when there are choices on multiple pages, such as key config,
Changed to suggest that there is another page when there are multiple pages of options, key configurations, etc.
But it doesn't look cool, so we will improve it to make it look better at a later date.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvement 1/24
notes.content:
Bug fixes
-Fixed a bug where the gimmick for escaping Hell would activate even under uncorrect conditions
-Changed so that the gimmick for escaping Hell will not activate just by touching it
-Fixed a bug where the Queen's friends in the water would continue to linger nearby
Improvements
-Changed the specifications of the big fish so that it will not appear during events.
-Signs have been placed outside the save points to make them a little easier to see.
-To gently guide you to the first save point you are likely to find. May be changed in the future
-Added a few signs to other locations
-Changed so that the checkpoint will be updated just by touching a save point. It doesn't actually save!
A flag effect will now be displayed when the checkpoint is changed for reasons other than entering or leaving a room.
Please let us know if you feel it has become harder to use.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvement
notes.content:
Bug fixes
-Fixed a bug where a lot of snakes would fall before opening the Queen of Snakes' treasure chest
-Fixed a bug where images from conversations and explanations would remain
-Fixed a bug where music would not switch to map-specific music when using a warp device
-Fixed a bug where music and effects would not play properly when defeating some queen-related special enemies
-Fixed the behavior of some zombies that were not working properly

Improvement
-In maps where the main character is in a special state, an icon will now be displayed when a door can be used

notes.title: Bug fixes and new add
notes.content:
Bug fixes

-Fixed directional button display when using pad in tutorial

-Fixed crash when using certain weapons against some bosses

-Moved the position of the tutorial room so that it overlaps with the initial position

-Changed the specifications of some equipment when respawning after death to prevent respawn kills.

New additions

-Displays the current version in the title

-Added bomb dash and bomb jump to the initial bomb weapon. Jump in time with the blast to perform a high jump, and inputting left or right at this time will allow you to accelerate

-Slightly changed dash specifications in accordance with the above, and relaxed dash conditions when no items are in possession
